item.title: UNC’s Veesaar increasing practice work ahead of Syracuse game; Wilson due for evaluation next week
item.description: Henri Veesaar would return to limited practice Friday while freshman star Caleb Wilson will have another evaluation next week as both players recover from injuries, North Carolina coach Hubert Davis said.

item.title: Church in Chadbourn closes, but still alive in spirit
